newsitem.title: CHINA: China seen producing 1.6 mln vehicles in 1997.
newsitem.headline: China seen producing 1.6 mln vehicles in 1997.

text.p: China's production of motor vehicles is expected to rise by 100,000 to 1.6 million in 1997, the China News Service said on Friday.
Demand for cars for private use and rental was forecast to increase this year, the news agency said.
A crackdown on smuggling and illegal assembly of cars and motorcycles was expected to boost sales of locally-made cars, especially sedans, it said.
China's car market slumped last year with production racing ahead of demand.
The gross output value of China's auto industry was estimated at 230 billion yuan ($27.7 billion) in 1996, the news agency said without giving further details.
